title: Chunky Storage Basket
description: A sturdy home project for practicing rounds, sides, and simple structure.
expectationText: A useful home piece where you move from a flat base into upright sides and see structure take shape.

steps.title: Start the base
steps.instruction: Make a magic ring and work 8 single crochet into the center.

steps.title: Rounds 1 to 4
steps.instruction: Increase evenly each round until the base reaches the width you want.

steps.title: Turn the side
steps.instruction: Work one round in the back loops only to create a clean edge.

steps.title: Build the walls
steps.instruction: Single crochet around without increasing until the basket is tall enough.

steps.title: Finish the rim
steps.instruction: Slip stitch around the top edge, fasten off, and weave in ends.
